VerseWithoutHarakat: وجوه يومئذ مسفرة
VerseEnglish: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright

VerseWithHarakat: ضَاحِكَةٞ مُّسۡتَبۡشِرَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ضاحكة مستبشرة
VerseEnglish: Laughing, rejoicing at good news

VerseWithHarakat: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ووجوه يومئذ عليها غبرة
VerseEnglish: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust

VerseWithHarakat: تَرۡهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ترهقها قترة
VerseEnglish: Blackness will cover them

VerseWithHarakat: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أولئك هم الكفرة الفجرة
VerseEnglish: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones

VerseWithHarakat: إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إذا الشمس كورت
VerseEnglish: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا النجوم انكدرت
VerseEnglish: And when the stars fall, dispersing

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا الجبال سيرت
VerseEnglish: And when the mountains are removed

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا العشار عطلت
VerseEnglish: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا الوحوش حشرت
VerseEnglish: And when the wild beasts are gathered

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا البحار سجرت
VerseEnglish: And when the seas are filled with flame

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا النفوس زوجت
VerseEnglish: And when the souls are paired

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡمَوۡءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا الموءودة سئلت
VerseEnglish: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

VerseWithHarakat: بِأَيِّ ذَنۢبٖ قُتِلَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بأي ذنب قتلت
VerseEnglish: For what sin she was killed

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا الصحف نشرت
VerseEnglish: And when the pages are made public

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا السماء كشطت
VerseEnglish: And when the sky is stripped away

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا الجحيم سعرت
VerseEnglish: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَنَّةُ أُزۡلِفَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا الجنة أزلفت
VerseEnglish: And when Paradise is brought near

VerseWithHarakat: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: علمت نفس ما أحضرت
VerseEnglish: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it]

VerseWithHarakat: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلۡخُنَّسِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فلا أقسم بالخنس
VerseEnglish: So I swear by the retreating stars

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلۡجَوَارِ ٱلۡكُنَّسِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الجوار الكنس
VerseEnglish: Those that run [their courses] and disappear

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والليل إذا عسعس
VerseEnglish: And by the night as it closes in

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والصبح إذا تنفس
VerseEnglish: And by the dawn when it breathes

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلُ رَسُولٖ كَرِيمٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إنه لقول رسول كريم
VerseEnglish: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

VerseWithHarakat: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ذي قوة عند ذي العرش مكين
VerseEnglish: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position]

VerseWithHarakat: مُّطَاعٖ ثَمَّ أَمِينٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: مطاع ثم أمين
VerseEnglish: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجۡنُونٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما صاحبكم بمجنون
VerseEnglish: And your companion is not [at all] mad

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولقد رآه بالأفق المبين
VerseEnglish: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلۡغَيۡبِ بِضَنِينٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما هو على الغيب بضنين
VerseEnglish: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَيۡطَٰنٖ رَّجِيمٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما هو بقول شيطان رجيم
VerseEnglish: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens]

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَيۡنَ تَذۡهَبُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأين تذهبون
VerseEnglish: So where are you going

VerseWithHarakat: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرٞ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن هو إلا ذكر للعالمين
VerseEnglish: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

VerseWithHarakat: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لمن شاء منكم أن يستقيم
VerseEnglish: For whoever wills among you to take a right course

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء الله رب العالمين
VerseEnglish: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds

VerseWithHarakat: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إذا السماء انفطرت
VerseEnglish: When the sky breaks apart

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا الكواكب انتثرت
VerseEnglish: And when the stars fall, scattering

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا البحار فجرت
VerseEnglish: And when the seas are erupted

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡقُبُورُ بُعۡثِرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا القبور بعثرت
VerseEnglish: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered

VerseWithHarakat: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: علمت نفس ما قدمت وأخرت
VerseEnglish: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back

VerseWithHarakat: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يا أيها الإنسان ما غرك بربك الكريم
VerseEnglish: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي خلقك فسواك فعدلك
VerseEnglish: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you

VerseWithHarakat: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: في أي صورة ما شاء ركبك
VerseEnglish: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّا بَلۡ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا بل تكذبون بالدين
VerseEnglish: No! But you deny the Recompense

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإن عليكم لحافظين
VerseEnglish: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers

VerseWithHarakat: كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كراما كاتبين
VerseEnglish: Noble and recording

VerseWithHarakat: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يعلمون ما تفعلون
VerseEnglish: They know whatever you do

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الأبرار لفي نعيم
VerseEnglish: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِنَّ ٱلۡفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإن الفجار لفي جحيم
VerseEnglish: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire

VerseWithHarakat: يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يصلونها يوم الدين
VerseEnglish: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما هم عنها بغائبين
VerseEnglish: And never therefrom will they be absent

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما يوم الدين
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم ما أدراك ما يوم الدين
VerseEnglish: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense

VerseWithHarakat: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يوم لا تملك نفس لنفس شيئا والأمر يومئذ لله
VerseEnglish: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah

VerseWithHarakat: وَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُطَفِّفِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ويل للمطففين
VerseEnglish: Woe to those who give less [than due]

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذين إذا اكتالوا على الناس يستوفون
VerseEnglish: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمۡ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمۡ يُخۡسِرُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا كالوهم أو وزنوهم يخسرون
VerseEnglish: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبۡعُوثُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ألا يظن أولئك أنهم مبعوثون
VerseEnglish: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

VerseWithHarakat: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ليوم عظيم
VerseEnglish: For a tremendous Day

VerseWithHarakat: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يوم يقوم الناس لرب العالمين
VerseEnglish: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا إن كتاب الفجار لفي سجين
VerseEnglish: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما سجين
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what is sijjeen

VerseWithHarakat: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كتاب مرقوم
VerseEnglish: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

VerseWithHarakat: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
VerseEnglish: Woe, that Day, to the deniers

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذين يكذبون بيوم الدين
VerseEnglish: Who deny the Day of Recompense

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما يكذب به إلا كل معتد أثيم
VerseEnglish: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor

VerseWithHarakat: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إذا تتلى عليه آياتنا قال أساطير الأولين
VerseEnglish: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا بل ران على قلوبهم ما كانوا يكسبون
VerseEnglish: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا إنهم عن ربهم يومئذ لمحجوبون
VerseEnglish: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم إنهم لصالو الجحيم
VerseEnglish: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم يقال هذا الذي كنتم به تكذبون
VerseEnglish: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا إن كتاب الأبرار لفي عليين
VerseEnglish: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما عليون
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun

VerseWithHarakat: كِتَٰبٞ مَّرۡقُومٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كتاب مرقوم
VerseEnglish: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

VerseWithHarakat: يَشۡهَدُهُ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يشهده المقربون
VerseEnglish: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الأبرار لفي نعيم
VerseEnglish: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

VerseWithHarakat: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: على الأرائك ينظرون
VerseEnglish: On adorned couches, observing

VerseWithHarakat: تَعۡرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمۡ نَضۡرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: تعرف في وجوههم نضرة النعيم
VerseEnglish: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure

VerseWithHarakat: يُسۡقَوۡنَ مِن رَّحِيقٖ مَّخۡتُومٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يسقون من رحيق مختوم
VerseEnglish: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed

VerseWithHarakat: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ختامه مسك وفي ذلك فليتنافس المتنافسون
VerseEnglish: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete

VerseWithHarakat: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسۡنِيمٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ومزاجه من تسنيم
VerseEnglish: And its mixture is of Tasneem

VerseWithHarakat: عَيۡنٗا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: عينا يشرب بها المقربون
VerseEnglish: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الذين أجرموا كانوا من الذين آمنوا يضحكون
VerseEnglish: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمۡ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا مروا بهم يتغامزون
VerseEnglish: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا انقلبوا إلى أهلهم انقلبوا فكهين
VerseEnglish: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا رأوهم قالوا إن هؤلاء لضالون
VerseEnglish: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أُرۡسِلُواْ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَٰفِظِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أرسلوا عليهم حافظين
VerseEnglish: But they had not been sent as guardians over them

VerseWithHarakat: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فاليوم الذين آمنوا من الكفار يضحكون
VerseEnglish: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers

VerseWithHarakat: عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: على الأرائك ينظرون
VerseEnglish: On adorned couches, observing

VerseWithHarakat: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: هل ثوب الكفار ما كانوا يفعلون
VerseEnglish: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do

VerseWithHarakat: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إذا السماء انشقت
VerseEnglish: When the sky has split [open]

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأذنت لربها وحقت
VerseEnglish: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا الأرض مدت
VerseEnglish: And when the earth has been extended

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وألقت ما فيها وتخلت
VerseEnglish: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأذنت لربها وحقت
VerseEnglish: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

VerseWithHarakat: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يا أيها الإنسان إنك كادح إلى ربك كدحا فملاقيه
VerseEnglish: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأما من أوتي كتابه بيمينه
VerseEnglish: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand

VerseWithHarakat: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابٗا يَسِيرٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فسوف يحاسب حسابا يسيرا
VerseEnglish: He will be judged with an easy account

VerseWithHarakat: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: وينقلب إلى أهله مسرورا
VerseEnglish: And return to his people in happiness

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأما من أوتي كتابه وراء ظهره
VerseEnglish: But as for he who is given his record behind his back

VerseWithHarakat: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فسوف يدعو ثبورا
VerseEnglish: He will cry out for destruction

VerseWithHarakat: وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
VerseWithoutHarakat: ويصلى سعيرا
VerseEnglish: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا
VerseWithoutHarakat: إنه كان في أهله مسرورا
VerseEnglish: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إنه ظن أن لن يحور
VerseEnglish: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]

VerseWithHarakat: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: بلى إن ربه كان به بصيرا
VerseEnglish: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing

VerseWithHarakat: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فلا أقسم بالشفق
VerseEnglish: So I swear by the twilight glow

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والليل وما وسق
VerseEnglish: And [by] the night and what it envelops

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والقمر إذا اتسق
VerseEnglish: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

VerseWithHarakat: لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لتركبن طبقا عن طبق
VerseEnglish: [That] you will surely experience state after state

VerseWithHarakat: فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فما لهم لا يؤمنون
VerseEnglish: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإذا قرئ عليهم القرآن لا يسجدون
VerseEnglish: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]

VerseWithHarakat: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بل الذين كفروا يكذبون
VerseEnglish: But those who have disbelieved deny

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والله أعلم بما يوعون
VerseEnglish: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves

VerseWithHarakat: فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فبشرهم بعذاب أليم
VerseEnglish: So give them tidings of a painful punishment

VerseWithHarakat: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم أجر غير ممنون
VerseEnglish: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡبُرُوجِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والسماء ذات البروج
VerseEnglish: By the sky containing great stars

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: واليوم الموعود
VerseEnglish: And [by] the promised Day

VerseWithHarakat: وَشَاهِدٖ وَمَشۡهُودٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وشاهد ومشهود
VerseEnglish: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed

VerseWithHarakat: قُتِلَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأُخۡدُودِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: قتل أصحاب الأخدود
VerseEnglish: Cursed were the companions of the trench

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلۡوَقُودِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: النار ذات الوقود
VerseEnglish: [Containing] the fire full of fuel

VerseWithHarakat: إِذۡ هُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا قُعُودٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إذ هم عليها قعود
VerseEnglish: When they were sitting near it

VerseWithHarakat: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وهم على ما يفعلون بالمؤمنين شهود
VerseEnglish: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما نقموا منهم إلا أن يؤمنوا بالله العزيز الحميد
VerseEnglish: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي له ملك السماوات والأرض والله على كل شيء شهيد
VerseEnglish: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الذين فتنوا المؤمنين والمؤمنات ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب الحريق
VerseEnglish: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار ذلك الفوز الكبير
VerseEnglish: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ بَطۡشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن بطش ربك لشديد
VerseEnglish: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبۡدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إنه هو يبدئ ويعيد
VerseEnglish: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats

VerseWithHarakat: وَهُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلۡوَدُودُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وهو الغفور الودود
VerseEnglish: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate

VerseWithHarakat: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ذو العرش المجيد
VerseEnglish: Honorable Owner of the Throne

VerseWithHarakat: فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فعال لما يريد
VerseEnglish: Effecter of what He intends

VerseWithHarakat: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡجُنُودِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: هل أتاك حديث الجنود
VerseEnglish: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers

VerseWithHarakat: فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَثَمُودَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فرعون وثمود
VerseEnglish: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud

VerseWithHarakat: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي تَكۡذِيبٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بل الذين كفروا في تكذيب
VerseEnglish: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطُۢ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والله من ورائهم محيط
VerseEnglish: While Allah encompasses them from behind

VerseWithHarakat: بَلۡ هُوَ قُرۡءَانٞ مَّجِيدٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بل هو قرآن مجيد
VerseEnglish: But this is an honored Qur'an

VerseWithHarakat: فِي لَوۡحٖ مَّحۡفُوظِۭ
VerseWithoutHarakat: في لوح محفوظ
VerseEnglish: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والسماء والطارق
VerseEnglish: By the sky and the night comer

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما الطارق
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what is the night comer

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلنَّجۡمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: النجم الثاقب
VerseEnglish: It is the piercing star

VerseWithHarakat: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن كل نفس لما عليها حافظ
VerseEnglish: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector

VerseWithHarakat: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فلينظر الإنسان مم خلق
VerseEnglish: So let man observe from what he was created

VerseWithHarakat: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٖ دَافِقٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: خلق من ماء دافق
VerseEnglish: He was created from a fluid, ejected

VerseWithHarakat: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يخرج من بين الصلب والترائب
VerseEnglish: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إنه على رجعه لقادر
VerseEnglish: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able

VerseWithHarakat: يَوۡمَ تُبۡلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يوم تبلى السرائر
VerseEnglish: The Day when secrets will be put on trial

VerseWithHarakat: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فما له من قوة ولا ناصر
VerseEnglish: Then man will have no power or any helper

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجۡعِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والسماء ذات الرجع
VerseEnglish: By the sky which returns [rain]

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدۡعِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والأرض ذات الصدع
VerseEnglish: And [by] the earth which cracks open

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوۡلٞ فَصۡلٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إنه لقول فصل
VerseEnglish: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلۡهَزۡلِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما هو بالهزل
VerseEnglish: And it is not amusement

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّهُمۡ يَكِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: إنهم يكيدون كيدا
VerseEnglish: Indeed, they are planning a plan

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَكِيدُ كَيۡدٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأكيد كيدا
VerseEnglish: But I am planning a plan

VerseWithHarakat: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فمهل الكافرين أمهلهم رويدا
VerseEnglish: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile

VerseWithHarakat: سَبِّحِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَى
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم سبح اسم ربك الأعلى
VerseEnglish: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي خلق فسوى
VerseEnglish: Who created and proportioned

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والذي قدر فهدى
VerseEnglish: And who destined and [then] guided

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ ٱلۡمَرۡعَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والذي أخرج المرعى
VerseEnglish: And who brings out the pasture

VerseWithHarakat: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحۡوَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فجعله غثاء أحوى
VerseEnglish: And [then] makes it black stubble

VerseWithHarakat: سَنُقۡرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: سنقرئك فلا تنسى
VerseEnglish: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget

VerseWithHarakat: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إلا ما شاء الله إنه يعلم الجهر وما يخفى
VerseEnglish: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden

VerseWithHarakat: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ونيسرك لليسرى
VerseEnglish: And We will ease you toward ease

VerseWithHarakat: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فذكر إن نفعت الذكرى
VerseEnglish: So remind, if the reminder should benefit

VerseWithHarakat: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: سيذكر من يخشى
VerseEnglish: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded

VerseWithHarakat: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
VerseWithoutHarakat: ويتجنبها الأشقى
VerseEnglish: But the wretched one will avoid it

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي يَصۡلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي يصلى النار الكبرى
VerseEnglish: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيى
VerseEnglish: Neither dying therein nor living

VerseWithHarakat: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: قد أفلح من تزكى
VerseEnglish: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

VerseWithHarakat: وَذَكَرَ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وذكر اسم ربه فصلى
VerseEnglish: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays

VerseWithHarakat: بَلۡ تُؤۡثِرُونَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: بل تؤثرون الحياة الدنيا
VerseEnglish: But you prefer the worldly life

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والآخرة خير وأبقى
VerseEnglish: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن هذا لفي الصحف الأولى
VerseEnglish: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures

VerseWithHarakat: صُحُفِ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: صحف إبراهيم وموسى
VerseEnglish: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses

VerseWithHarakat: هَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلۡغَٰشِيَةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم هل أتاك حديث الغاشية
VerseEnglish: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]

VerseWithHarakat: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وجوه يومئذ خاشعة
VerseEnglish: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled

VerseWithHarakat: عَامِلَةٞ نَّاصِبَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: عاملة ناصبة
VerseEnglish: Working [hard] and exhausted

VerseWithHarakat: تَصۡلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةٗ
VerseWithoutHarakat: تصلى نارا حامية
VerseEnglish: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire

VerseWithHarakat: تُسۡقَىٰ مِنۡ عَيۡنٍ ءَانِيَةٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: تسقى من عين آنية
VerseEnglish: They will be given drink from a boiling spring

VerseWithHarakat: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ليس لهم طعام إلا من ضريع
VerseEnglish: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

VerseWithHarakat: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع
VerseEnglish: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger

VerseWithHarakat: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاعِمَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وجوه يومئذ ناعمة
VerseEnglish: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure

VerseWithHarakat: لِّسَعۡيِهَا رَاضِيَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لسعيها راضية
VerseEnglish: With their effort [they are] satisfied

VerseWithHarakat: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: في جنة عالية
VerseEnglish: In an elevated garden

VerseWithHarakat: لَّا تَسۡمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةٗ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لا تسمع فيها لاغية
VerseEnglish: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech

VerseWithHarakat: فِيهَا عَيۡنٞ جَارِيَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فيها عين جارية
VerseEnglish: Within it is a flowing spring

VerseWithHarakat: فِيهَا سُرُرٞ مَّرۡفُوعَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فيها سرر مرفوعة
VerseEnglish: Within it are couches raised high

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَكۡوَابٞ مَّوۡضُوعَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأكواب موضوعة
VerseEnglish: And cups put in place

VerseWithHarakat: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصۡفُوفَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ونمارق مصفوفة
VerseEnglish: And cushions lined up

VerseWithHarakat: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبۡثُوثَةٌ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وزرابي مبثوثة
VerseEnglish: And carpets spread around

VerseWithHarakat: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أفلا ينظرون إلى الإبل كيف خلقت
VerseEnglish: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ رُفِعَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإلى السماء كيف رفعت
VerseEnglish: And at the sky - how it is raised

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِلَى ٱلۡجِبَالِ كَيۡفَ نُصِبَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإلى الجبال كيف نصبت
VerseEnglish: And at the mountains - how they are erected

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإلى الأرض كيف سطحت
VerseEnglish: And at the earth - how it is spread out

VerseWithHarakat: فَذَكِّرۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فذكر إنما أنت مذكر
VerseEnglish: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder

VerseWithHarakat: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لست عليهم بمصيطر
VerseEnglish: You are not over them a controller

VerseWithHarakat: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إلا من تولى وكفر
VerseEnglish: However, he who turns away and disbelieves

VerseWithHarakat: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فيعذبه الله العذاب الأكبر
VerseEnglish: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن إلينا إيابهم
VerseEnglish: Indeed, to Us is their return

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم إن علينا حسابهم
VerseEnglish: Then indeed, upon Us is their account

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡفَجۡرِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والفجر
VerseEnglish: By the dawn

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَيَالٍ عَشۡرٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وليال عشر
VerseEnglish: And [by] ten nights

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلشَّفۡعِ وَٱلۡوَتۡرِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والشفع والوتر
VerseEnglish: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَسۡرِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والليل إذا يسر
VerseEnglish: And [by] the night when it passes

VerseWithHarakat: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: هل في ذلك قسم لذي حجر
VerseEnglish: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بعاد
VerseEnglish: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad

VerseWithHarakat: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلۡعِمَادِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إرم ذات العماد
VerseEnglish: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: التي لم يخلق مثلها في البلاد
VerseEnglish: The likes of whom had never been created in the land

VerseWithHarakat: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وثمود الذين جابوا الصخر بالواد
VerseEnglish: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley

VerseWithHarakat: وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ ذِي ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وفرعون ذي الأوتاد
VerseEnglish: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذين طغوا في البلاد
VerseEnglish: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَكۡثَرُواْ فِيهَا ٱلۡفَسَادَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأكثروا فيها الفساد
VerseEnglish: And increased therein the corruption

VerseWithHarakat: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فصب عليهم ربك سوط عذاب
VerseEnglish: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن ربك لبالمرصاد
VerseEnglish: Indeed, your Lord is in observation

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأما الإنسان إذا ما ابتلاه ربه فأكرمه ونعمه فيقول ربي أكرمن
VerseEnglish: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأما إذا ما ابتلاه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربي أهانن
VerseEnglish: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّاۖ بَل لَّا تُكۡرِمُونَ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا بل لا تكرمون اليتيم
VerseEnglish: No! But you do not honor the orphan

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولا تحاضون على طعام المسكين
VerseEnglish: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor

VerseWithHarakat: وَتَأۡكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكۡلٗا لَّمّٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: وتأكلون التراث أكلا لما
VerseEnglish: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether

VerseWithHarakat: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡمَالَ حُبّٗا جَمّٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: وتحبون المال حبا جما
VerseEnglish: And you love wealth with immense love

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا إذا دكت الأرض دكا دكا
VerseEnglish: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed

VerseWithHarakat: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفّٗا صَفّٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: وجاء ربك والملك صفا صفا
VerseEnglish: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank

VerseWithHarakat: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وجيء يومئذ بجهنم يومئذ يتذكر الإنسان وأنى له الذكرى
VerseEnglish: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance

VerseWithHarakat: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي قَدَّمۡتُ لِحَيَاتِي
VerseWithoutHarakat: يقول يا ليتني قدمت لحياتي
VerseEnglish: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life

VerseWithHarakat: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فيومئذ لا يعذب عذابه أحد
VerseEnglish: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولا يوثق وثاقه أحد
VerseEnglish: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers]

VerseWithHarakat: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفۡسُ ٱلۡمُطۡمَئِنَّةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يا أيتها النفس المطمئنة
VerseEnglish: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul

VerseWithHarakat: ٱرۡجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةٗ مَّرۡضِيَّةٗ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ارجعي إلى ربك راضية مرضية
VerseEnglish: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him]

VerseWithHarakat: فَٱدۡخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي
VerseWithoutHarakat: فادخلي في عبادي
VerseEnglish: And enter among My [righteous] servants

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي
VerseWithoutHarakat: وادخلي جنتي
VerseEnglish: And enter My Paradise

VerseWithHarakat: لَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم لا أقسم بهذا البلد
VerseEnglish: I swear by this city, Makkah

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَنتَ حِلُّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأنت حل بهذا البلد
VerseEnglish: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city

VerseWithHarakat: وَوَالِدٖ وَمَا وَلَدَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ووالد وما ولد
VerseEnglish: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him]

VerseWithHarakat: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِي كَبَدٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لقد خلقنا الإنسان في كبد
VerseEnglish: We have certainly created man into hardship

VerseWithHarakat: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أيحسب أن لن يقدر عليه أحد
VerseEnglish: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him

VerseWithHarakat: يَقُولُ أَهۡلَكۡتُ مَالٗا لُّبَدًا
VerseWithoutHarakat: يقول أهلكت مالا لبدا
VerseEnglish: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance

VerseWithHarakat: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّمۡ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أيحسب أن لم يره أحد
VerseEnglish: Does he think that no one has seen him

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَمۡ نَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ عَيۡنَيۡنِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ألم نجعل له عينين
VerseEnglish: Have We not made for him two eyes

VerseWithHarakat: وَلِسَانٗا وَشَفَتَيۡنِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولسانا وشفتين
VerseEnglish: And a tongue and two lips

VerseWithHarakat: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وهديناه النجدين
VerseEnglish: And have shown him the two ways

VerseWithHarakat: فَلَا ٱقۡتَحَمَ ٱلۡعَقَبَةَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فلا اقتحم العقبة
VerseEnglish: But he has not broken through the difficult pass

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡعَقَبَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما العقبة
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass

VerseWithHarakat: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فك رقبة
VerseEnglish: It is the freeing of a slave

VerseWithHarakat: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أو إطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة
VerseEnglish: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

VerseWithHarakat: يَتِيمٗا ذَا مَقۡرَبَةٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يتيما ذا مقربة
VerseEnglish: An orphan of near relationship

VerseWithHarakat: أَوۡ مِسۡكِينٗا ذَا مَتۡرَبَةٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أو مسكينا ذا متربة
VerseEnglish: Or a needy person in misery

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم كان من الذين آمنوا وتواصوا بالصبر وتواصوا بالمرحمة
VerseEnglish: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion

VerseWithHarakat: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَيۡمَنَةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أولئك أصحاب الميمنة
VerseEnglish: Those are the companions of the right

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والذين كفروا بآياتنا هم أصحاب المشأمة
VerseEnglish: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left

VerseWithHarakat: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٞ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ
VerseWithoutHarakat: عليهم نار مؤصدة
VerseEnglish: Over them will be fire closed in

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلشَّمۡسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والشمس وضحاها
VerseEnglish: By the sun and its brightness

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: والقمر إذا تلاها
VerseEnglish: And [by] the moon when it follows it

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: والنهار إذا جلاها
VerseEnglish: And [by] the day when it displays it

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: والليل إذا يغشاها
VerseEnglish: And [by] the night when it covers it

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: والسماء وما بناها
VerseEnglish: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: والأرض وما طحاها
VerseEnglish: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

VerseWithHarakat: وَنَفۡسٖ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: ونفس وما سواها
VerseEnglish: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فألهمها فجورها وتقواها
VerseEnglish: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness

VerseWithHarakat: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: قد أفلح من زكاها
VerseEnglish: He has succeeded who purifies it

VerseWithHarakat: وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: وقد خاب من دساها
VerseEnglish: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]

VerseWithHarakat: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِطَغۡوَىٰهَآ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كذبت ثمود بطغواها
VerseEnglish: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression

VerseWithHarakat: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشۡقَىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: إذ انبعث أشقاها
VerseEnglish: When the most wretched of them was sent forth

VerseWithHarakat: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فقال لهم رسول الله ناقة الله وسقياها
VerseEnglish: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink

VerseWithHarakat: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فكذبوه فعقروها فدمدم عليهم ربهم بذنبهم فسواها
VerseEnglish: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقۡبَٰهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولا يخاف عقباها
VerseEnglish: And He does not fear the consequence thereof

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا يَغۡشَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والليل إذا يغشى
VerseEnglish: By the night when it covers

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والنهار إذا تجلى
VerseEnglish: And [by] the day when it appears

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما خلق الذكر والأنثى
VerseEnglish: And [by] He who created the male and female

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ سَعۡيَكُمۡ لَشَتَّىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن سعيكم لشتى
VerseEnglish: Indeed, your efforts are diverse

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أَعۡطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأما من أعطى واتقى
VerseEnglish: As for he who gives and fears Allah

VerseWithHarakat: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وصدق بالحسنى
VerseEnglish: And believes in the best [reward]

VerseWithHarakat: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡيُسۡرَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فسنيسره لليسرى
VerseEnglish: We will ease him toward ease

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأما من بخل واستغنى
VerseEnglish: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

VerseWithHarakat: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وكذب بالحسنى
VerseEnglish: And denies the best [reward]

VerseWithHarakat: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فسنيسره للعسرى
VerseEnglish: We will ease him toward difficulty

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما يغني عنه ماله إذا تردى
VerseEnglish: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن علينا للهدى
VerseEnglish: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإن لنا للآخرة والأولى
VerseEnglish: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأنذرتكم نارا تلظى
VerseEnglish: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing

VerseWithHarakat: لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى
VerseWithoutHarakat: لا يصلاها إلا الأشقى
VerseEnglish: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي كذب وتولى
VerseEnglish: Who had denied and turned away

VerseWithHarakat: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلۡأَتۡقَى
VerseWithoutHarakat: وسيجنبها الأتقى
VerseEnglish: But the righteous one will avoid it

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي يُؤۡتِي مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي يؤتي ماله يتزكى
VerseEnglish: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما لأحد عنده من نعمة تجزى
VerseEnglish: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

VerseWithHarakat: إِلَّا ٱبۡتِغَآءَ وَجۡهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إلا ابتغاء وجه ربه الأعلى
VerseEnglish: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولسوف يرضى
VerseEnglish: And he is going to be satisfied

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والضحى
VerseEnglish: By the morning brightness

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: والليل إذا سجى
VerseEnglish: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness

VerseWithHarakat: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ما ودعك ربك وما قلى
VerseEnglish: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَلۡأٓخِرَةُ خَيۡرٞ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وللآخرة خير لك من الأولى
VerseEnglish: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَسَوۡفَ يُعۡطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرۡضَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولسوف يعطيك ربك فترضى
VerseEnglish: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَمۡ يَجِدۡكَ يَتِيمٗا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ألم يجدك يتيما فآوى
VerseEnglish: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge

VerseWithHarakat: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلّٗا فَهَدَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ووجدك ضالا فهدى
VerseEnglish: And He found you lost and guided [you]

VerseWithHarakat: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلٗا فَأَغۡنَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ووجدك عائلا فأغنى
VerseEnglish: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأما اليتيم فلا تقهر
VerseEnglish: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنۡهَرۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأما السائل فلا تنهر
VerseEnglish: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَمَّا بِنِعۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأما بنعمة ربك فحدث
VerseEnglish: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ألم نشرح لك صدرك
VerseEnglish: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast

VerseWithHarakat: وَوَضَعۡنَا عَنكَ وِزۡرَكَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ووضعنا عنك وزرك
VerseEnglish: And We removed from you your burden

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهۡرَكَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي أنقض ظهرك
VerseEnglish: Which had weighed upon your back

VerseWithHarakat: وَرَفَعۡنَا لَكَ ذِكۡرَكَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ورفعنا لك ذكرك
VerseEnglish: And raised high for you your repute

VerseWithHarakat: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرًا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فإن مع العسر يسرا
VerseEnglish: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن مع العسر يسرا
VerseEnglish: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease

VerseWithHarakat: فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فإذا فرغت فانصب
VerseEnglish: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإلى ربك فارغب
VerseEnglish: And to your Lord direct [your] longing

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيۡتُونِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والتين والزيتون
VerseEnglish: By the fig and the olive

VerseWithHarakat: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وطور سينين
VerseEnglish: And [by] Mount Sinai

VerseWithHarakat: وَهَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدِ ٱلۡأَمِينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وهذا البلد الأمين
VerseEnglish: And [by] this secure city [Makkah]

VerseWithHarakat: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لقد خلقنا الإنسان في أحسن تقويم
VerseEnglish: We have certainly created man in the best of stature

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ رَدَدۡنَٰهُ أَسۡفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم رددناه أسفل سافلين
VerseEnglish: Then We return him to the lowest of the low

VerseWithHarakat: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات فلهم أجر غير ممنون
VerseEnglish: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted

VerseWithHarakat: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعۡدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فما يكذبك بعد بالدين
VerseEnglish: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحۡكَمِ ٱلۡحَٰكِمِينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أليس الله بأحكم الحاكمين
VerseEnglish: Is not Allah the most just of judges

VerseWithHarakat: ٱقۡرَأۡ بِٱسۡمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اقرأ باسم ربك الذي خلق
VerseEnglish: Recite in the name of your Lord who created

VerseWithHarakat: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِنۡ عَلَقٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: خلق الإنسان من علق
VerseEnglish: Created man from a clinging substance

VerseWithHarakat: ٱقۡرَأۡ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلۡأَكۡرَمُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: اقرأ وربك الأكرم
VerseEnglish: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلۡقَلَمِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي علم بالقلم
VerseEnglish: Who taught by the pen

VerseWithHarakat: عَلَّمَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: علم الإنسان ما لم يعلم
VerseEnglish: Taught man that which he knew not

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطۡغَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا إن الإنسان ليطغى
VerseEnglish: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses

VerseWithHarakat: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسۡتَغۡنَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أن رآه استغنى
VerseEnglish: Because he sees himself self-sufficient

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجۡعَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن إلى ربك الرجعى
VerseEnglish: Indeed, to your Lord is the return

VerseWithHarakat: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يَنۡهَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أرأيت الذي ينهى
VerseEnglish: Have you seen the one who forbids

VerseWithHarakat: عَبۡدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: عبدا إذا صلى
VerseEnglish: A servant when he prays

VerseWithHarakat: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أرأيت إن كان على الهدى
VerseEnglish: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

VerseWithHarakat: أَوۡ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقۡوَىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أو أمر بالتقوى
VerseEnglish: Or enjoins righteousness

VerseWithHarakat: أَرَءَيۡتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أرأيت إن كذب وتولى
VerseEnglish: Have you seen if he denies and turns away

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ألم يعلم بأن الله يرى
VerseEnglish: Does he not know that Allah sees

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا لئن لم ينته لنسفعا بالناصية
VerseEnglish: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock

VerseWithHarakat: نَاصِيَةٖ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ناصية كاذبة خاطئة
VerseEnglish: A lying, sinning forelock

VerseWithHarakat: فَلۡيَدۡعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فليدع ناديه
VerseEnglish: Then let him call his associates

VerseWithHarakat: سَنَدۡعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: سندع الزبانية
VerseEnglish: We will call the angels of Hell

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعۡهُ وَٱسۡجُدۡۤ وَٱقۡتَرِب۩
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا لا تطعه واسجد واقترب
VerseEnglish: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah]

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةِ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إنا أنزلناه في ليلة القدر
VerseEnglish: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما ليلة القدر
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree

VerseWithHarakat: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ليلة القدر خير من ألف شهر
VerseEnglish: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months

VerseWithHarakat: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: تنزل الملائكة والروح فيها بإذن ربهم من كل أمر
VerseEnglish: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter

VerseWithHarakat: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطۡلَعِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: سلام هي حتى مطلع الفجر
VerseEnglish: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn

VerseWithHarakat: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم لم يكن الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب والمشركين منفكين حتى تأتيهم البينة
VerseEnglish: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence

VerseWithHarakat: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ
VerseWithoutHarakat: رسول من الله يتلو صحفا مطهرة
VerseEnglish: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures

VerseWithHarakat: فِيهَا كُتُبٞ قَيِّمَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فيها كتب قيمة
VerseEnglish: Within which are correct writings

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما تفرق الذين أوتوا الكتاب إلا من بعد ما جاءتهم البينة
VerseEnglish: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أمروا إلا ليعبدوا الله مخلصين له الدين حنفاء ويقيموا الصلاة ويؤتوا الزكاة وذلك دين القيمة
VerseEnglish: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الذين كفروا من أهل الكتاب والمشركين في نار جهنم خالدين فيها أولئك هم شر البرية
VerseEnglish: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات أولئك هم خير البرية
VerseEnglish: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures

VerseWithHarakat: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ
VerseWithoutHarakat: جزاؤهم عند ربهم جنات عدن تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا رضي الله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك لمن خشي ربه
VerseEnglish: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord

VerseWithHarakat: إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إذا زلزلت الأرض زلزالها
VerseEnglish: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأخرجت الأرض أثقالها
VerseEnglish: And the earth discharges its burdens

VerseWithHarakat: وَقَالَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: وقال الإنسان ما لها
VerseEnglish: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it

VerseWithHarakat: يَوۡمَئِذٖ تُحَدِّثُ أَخۡبَارَهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: يومئذ تحدث أخبارها
VerseEnglish: That Day, it will report its news

VerseWithHarakat: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوۡحَىٰ لَهَا
VerseWithoutHarakat: بأن ربك أوحى لها
VerseEnglish: Because your Lord has commanded it

VerseWithHarakat: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يومئذ يصدر الناس أشتاتا ليروا أعمالهم
VerseEnglish: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds

VerseWithHarakat: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره
VerseEnglish: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره
VerseEnglish: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبۡحٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والعاديات ضبحا
VerseEnglish: By the racers, panting

VerseWithHarakat: فَٱلۡمُورِيَٰتِ قَدۡحٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فالموريات قدحا
VerseEnglish: And the producers of sparks [when] striking

VerseWithHarakat: فَٱلۡمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبۡحٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فالمغيرات صبحا
VerseEnglish: And the chargers at dawn

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَثَرۡنَ بِهِۦ نَقۡعٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأثرن به نقعا
VerseEnglish: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust

VerseWithHarakat: فَوَسَطۡنَ بِهِۦ جَمۡعًا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فوسطن به جمعا
VerseEnglish: Arriving thereby in the center collectively

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الإنسان لربه لكنود
VerseEnglish: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإنه على ذلك لشهيد
VerseEnglish: And indeed, he is to that a witness

VerseWithHarakat: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وإنه لحب الخير لشديد
VerseEnglish: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense

VerseWithHarakat: ۞أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: أفلا يعلم إذا بعثر ما في القبور
VerseEnglish: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered

VerseWithHarakat: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وحصل ما في الصدور
VerseEnglish: And that within the breasts is obtained

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّخَبِيرُۢ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن ربهم بهم يومئذ لخبير
VerseEnglish: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم القارعة
VerseEnglish: The Striking Calamity

VerseWithHarakat: مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ما القارعة
VerseEnglish: What is the Striking Calamity

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡقَارِعَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما القارعة
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity

VerseWithHarakat: يَوۡمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلۡفَرَاشِ ٱلۡمَبۡثُوثِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يوم يكون الناس كالفراش المبثوث
VerseEnglish: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed

VerseWithHarakat: وَتَكُونُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَٱلۡعِهۡنِ ٱلۡمَنفُوشِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وتكون الجبال كالعهن المنفوش
VerseEnglish: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up

VerseWithHarakat: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأما من ثقلت موازينه
VerseEnglish: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds]

VerseWithHarakat: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٖ رَّاضِيَةٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فهو في عيشة راضية
VerseEnglish: He will be in a pleasant life

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأما من خفت موازينه
VerseEnglish: But as for one whose scales are light

VerseWithHarakat: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فأمه هاوية
VerseEnglish: His refuge will be an abyss

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما هيه
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what that is

VerseWithHarakat: نَارٌ حَامِيَةُۢ
VerseWithoutHarakat: نار حامية
VerseEnglish: It is a Fire, intensely hot

VerseWithHarakat: أَلۡهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ألهاكم التكاثر
VerseEnglish: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you

VerseWithHarakat: حَتَّىٰ زُرۡتُمُ ٱلۡمَقَابِرَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: حتى زرتم المقابر
VerseEnglish: Until you visit the graveyards

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا سوف تعلمون
VerseEnglish: No! You are going to know

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم كلا سوف تعلمون
VerseEnglish: Then no! You are going to know

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّا لَوۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ عِلۡمَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا لو تعلمون علم اليقين
VerseEnglish: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty

VerseWithHarakat: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لترون الجحيم
VerseEnglish: You will surely see the Hellfire

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيۡنَ ٱلۡيَقِينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم لترونها عين اليقين
VerseEnglish: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

VerseWithHarakat: ثُمَّ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ثم لتسألن يومئذ عن النعيم
VerseEnglish: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والعصر
VerseEnglish: By time

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَفِي خُسۡرٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن الإنسان لفي خسر
VerseEnglish: Indeed, mankind is in loss

VerseWithHarakat: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إلا الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات وتواصوا بالحق وتواصوا بالصبر
VerseEnglish: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience

VerseWithHarakat: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٖ لُّمَزَةٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ويل لكل همزة لمزة
VerseEnglish: Woe to every scorner and mocker

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالٗا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي جمع مالا وعدده
VerseEnglish: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it

VerseWithHarakat: يَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخۡلَدَهُۥ
VerseWithoutHarakat: يحسب أن ماله أخلده
VerseEnglish: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal

VerseWithHarakat: كَلَّاۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِي ٱلۡحُطَمَةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: كلا لينبذن في الحطمة
VerseEnglish: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher

VerseWithHarakat: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحُطَمَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وما أدراك ما الحطمة
VerseEnglish: And what can make you know what is the Crusher

VerseWithHarakat: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمُوقَدَةُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: نار الله الموقدة
VerseEnglish: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: التي تطلع على الأفئدة
VerseEnglish: Which mounts directed at the hearts

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّهَا عَلَيۡهِم مُّؤۡصَدَةٞ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إنها عليهم مؤصدة
VerseEnglish: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them

VerseWithHarakat: فِي عَمَدٖ مُّمَدَّدَةِۭ
VerseWithoutHarakat: في عمد ممددة
VerseEnglish: In extended columns

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بأصحاب الفيل
VerseEnglish: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant

VerseWithHarakat: أَلَمۡ يَجۡعَلۡ كَيۡدَهُمۡ فِي تَضۡلِيلٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ألم يجعل كيدهم في تضليل
VerseEnglish: Did He not make their plan into misguidance

VerseWithHarakat: وَأَرۡسَلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ طَيۡرًا أَبَابِيلَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وأرسل عليهم طيرا أبابيل
VerseEnglish: And He sent against them birds in flocks

VerseWithHarakat: تَرۡمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٖ مِّن سِجِّيلٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ترميهم بحجارة من سجيل
VerseEnglish: Striking them with stones of hard clay

VerseWithHarakat: فَجَعَلَهُمۡ كَعَصۡفٖ مَّأۡكُولِۭ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فجعلهم كعصف مأكول
VerseEnglish: And He made them like eaten straw

VerseWithHarakat: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيۡشٍ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم لإيلاف قريش
VerseEnglish: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh

VerseWithHarakat: إِۦلَٰفِهِمۡ رِحۡلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيۡفِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إيلافهم رحلة الشتاء والصيف
VerseEnglish: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer

VerseWithHarakat: فَلۡيَعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَيۡتِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فليعبدوا رب هذا البيت
VerseEnglish: Let them worship the Lord of this House

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي أطعمهم من جوع وآمنهم من خوف
VerseEnglish: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear

VerseWithHarakat: أَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم أرأيت الذي يكذب بالدين
VerseEnglish: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense

VerseWithHarakat: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِي يَدُعُّ ٱلۡيَتِيمَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فذلك الذي يدع اليتيم
VerseEnglish: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولا يحض على طعام المسكين
VerseEnglish: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor

VerseWithHarakat: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُصَلِّينَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فويل للمصلين
VerseEnglish: So woe to those who pray

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَن صَلَاتِهِمۡ سَاهُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون
VerseEnglish: [But] who are heedless of their prayer

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذين هم يراءون
VerseEnglish: Those who make show [of their deeds]

VerseWithHarakat: وَيَمۡنَعُونَ ٱلۡمَاعُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ويمنعون الماعون
VerseEnglish: And withhold [simple] assistance

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّآ أَعۡطَيۡنَٰكَ ٱلۡكَوۡثَرَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إنا أعطيناك الكوثر
VerseEnglish: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar

VerseWithHarakat: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنۡحَرۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: فصل لربك وانحر
VerseEnglish: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]

VerseWithHarakat: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلۡأَبۡتَرُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إن شانئك هو الأبتر
VerseEnglish: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off

VerseWithHarakat: قُلۡ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل يا أيها الكافرون
VerseEnglish: Say, "O disbelievers

VerseWithHarakat: لَآ أَعۡبُدُ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لا أعبد ما تعبدون
VerseEnglish: I do not worship what you worship

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولا أنتم عابدون ما أعبد
VerseEnglish: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٞ مَّا عَبَدتُّمۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولا أنا عابد ما عبدتم
VerseEnglish: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعۡبُدُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولا أنتم عابدون ما أعبد
VerseEnglish: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship

VerseWithHarakat: لَكُمۡ دِينُكُمۡ وَلِيَ دِينِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لكم دينكم ولي دين
VerseEnglish: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion

VerseWithHarakat: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصۡرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡفَتۡحُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح
VerseEnglish: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest

VerseWithHarakat: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا
VerseWithoutHarakat: ورأيت الناس يدخلون في دين الله أفواجا
VerseEnglish: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes

VerseWithHarakat: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
VerseWithoutHarakat: فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره إنه كان توابا
VerseEnglish: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance

VerseWithHarakat: تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِي لَهَبٖ وَتَبَّ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم تبت يدا أبي لهب وتب
VerseEnglish: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he

VerseWithHarakat: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ما أغنى عنه ماله وما كسب
VerseEnglish: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained

VerseWithHarakat: سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارٗا ذَاتَ لَهَبٖ
VerseWithoutHarakat: سيصلى نارا ذات لهب
VerseEnglish: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame

VerseWithHarakat: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: وامرأته حمالة الحطب
VerseEnglish: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood

VerseWithHarakat: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبۡلٞ مِّن مَّسَدِۭ
VerseWithoutHarakat: في جيدها حبل من مسد
VerseEnglish: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber

VerseWithHarakat: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل هو الله أحد
VerseEnglish: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One

VerseWithHarakat: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الله الصمد
VerseEnglish: Allah, the Eternal Refuge

VerseWithHarakat: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ
VerseWithoutHarakat: لم يلد ولم يولد
VerseEnglish: He neither begets nor is born

VerseWithHarakat: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ولم يكن له كفوا أحد
VerseEnglish: Nor is there to Him any equivalent

VerseWithHarakat: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل أعوذ برب الفلق
VerseEnglish: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

VerseWithHarakat: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: من شر ما خلق
VerseEnglish: From the evil of that which He created

VerseWithHarakat: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ومن شر غاسق إذا وقب
VerseEnglish: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

VerseWithHarakat: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ومن شر النفاثات في العقد
VerseEnglish: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

VerseWithHarakat: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ومن شر حاسد إذا حسد
VerseEnglish: And from the evil of an envier when he envies

VerseWithHarakat: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قل أعوذ برب الناس
VerseEnglish: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind

VerseWithHarakat: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: ملك الناس
VerseEnglish: The Sovereign of mankind

VerseWithHarakat: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: إله الناس
VerseEnglish: The God of mankind

VerseWithHarakat: مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: من شر الوسواس الخناس
VerseEnglish: From the evil of the retreating whisperer

VerseWithHarakat: ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس
VerseEnglish: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind

VerseWithHarakat: مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
VerseWithoutHarakat: من الجنة والناس
VerseEnglish: From among the jinn and mankind
